# ONEZA Construction

> ONEZA Construction — full-cycle monolithic (cast-in-place concrete) construction in Tbilisi. Price, schedule and scope of works are fixed in the contract.

Site languages: Georgian (main, https://onez.ge/), Russian (https://onez.ge/ru/), English (https://onez.ge/en/). The same pages exist in each language, including "Build in Georgia" for non-resident clients.

## Company

- Full-cycle general contractor in Tbilisi, Georgia: monolithic reinforced concrete construction from the land check to handover ready for fit-out. Finishing works are not part of the scope.
- Residential buildings and apart-complexes from 1 000 m², up to 20 floors, 12–20 months.
- Warehouses, workshops and logistics centres from 1 000 m², up to 14 m clear height, 6–12 months.
- Private houses from 160 m², 1–3 floors, 8–14 months.
- Foundations (slab, strip, piled) and retaining walls can be ordered as a separate stage.
- 15-point land due diligence anywhere in Georgia, written report in 3 business days; free for clients who sign a construction contract with us, charged separately otherwise.
- Payment: 100% of materials and 15% of the work up front, the rest against stage acceptance acts. Structural warranty: 10 years. The contract price changes only if the client changes the brief.
- Working languages: Georgian, Russian, English.

## Prices

- Monolithic frame: from $140 / m²
- Shell with facade and windows: from $250 / m²
- Ready for fit-out, with utilities: from $300 / m²
- Payment: 100% of materials and 15% of the work up front, the rest against stage acceptance acts
- Structural warranty: 10 years
- Price change: Only if you change the brief

Indicative 2026 ranges for Tbilisi, materials and labour included, design and permits excluded. Your fixed price is set after the design stage.

## How a project goes

1. Site selection — 2–4 weeks
2. Legal due diligence — 3 working days
3. Design — 2–3 months
4. Permits — 1–3 months
5. Construction — 6–20 months
6. Handover — 2 weeks
